title: Verify: Submit success, API error and quota exhausted unit tests
summary: New test file asserting the three submit outcomes with fetch mocked
description: Write game/frontend/tests/contributionSheetSubmit.test.tsx with fetch stubbed, covering success, 500, 409 and quota exhausted.
technical_constraints: Reuse the stubFetch and json helper pattern from game/frontend/tests/contributionDialog.test.tsx

steps.action: Create the file with the jsdom pragma, the json/stubFetch helpers copied from contributionDialog.test.tsx, and a render helper for <ContributionSheet open onClose={vi.fn()} roundId="round-1" />. GET routes return json(200, []). Fixture: contributionFixture from game/frontend/tests/fixtures/api.ts, which mirrors contributionJSON in backend/internal/contribution/handler.go.
steps.command: cd game/frontend && npx vitest run tests/contributionSheetSubmit.test.tsx

steps.action: POST route returns json(201, contributionFixture). Type 'Look behind the shelf' into label 'Your idea', click Send, assert findByTestId('contribution-success') has text 'Suggestion sent' and queryByTestId('contribution-error') is null.
steps.command: cd game/frontend && npx vitest run tests/contributionSheetSubmit.test.tsx -t success

steps.action: Two tests: POST returns json(500,{error:'boom'}) and asserts contribution-error text 'Could not send'; POST returns json(409,{error:'limit'}) and asserts text 'Limit reached or duplicate idea'; both assert contribution-success is absent.
steps.command: cd game/frontend && npx vitest run tests/contributionSheetSubmit.test.tsx -t error

steps.action: GET returns json(200, five contributions built by spreading contributionFixture with distinct id and prompt). Assert findByTestId('contribution-quota') has text 'You have used all your suggestions this round', 'Send' button is disabled and no POST was made on the fetch mock.
steps.command: cd game/frontend && npx vitest run tests/contributionSheetSubmit.test.tsx
steps.expected: All tests in the file pass
